reviewer: /root/fold_transport, independently reviewing the original embedding worker evidence
result: Bounded reference audit complete. Retained host execution and arithmetic are internally consistent; independent model/reference qualification and production acceptance remain open.

performed: Read original packet, runner/tokenizer/quantizer/backend source, frozen corpus/gold, actual raw stages and original logs.
Rehashed all 1583 original manifest records, actual candidate weights, 6 classpath JARs, 9 acquisition records and the separately acquired pooling config.
Parsed the existing ONNX protobuf recursively and recomputed retained postprocessing only.
Verified all 12 published host files byte-for-byte against original retained files.
scope.preservation: Original raw stages, labels, thresholds, documents, models, owner state and old evidence remain untouched. Root owns Beads and integration. No runtime/default-model choice is made here.
scope.source_access: Pinned official metadata/model card contents were read locally and checked against retained authority records. No successful fresh web response is claimed.

evidence.reproduction: Run inspectors with python3 and the explicit --experiment/--decision/--repo or --model arguments in their argparse interfaces; choose new --output paths to preserve receipts. NumPy 2.5.3 and ONNX protobuf parser 1.23.0 were already installed. These inspectors never create an ORT session.
evidence.archive_limit: Metadata/card and original command/compiler logs only; no model weights, native libraries or owner content. Every member was re-read and compared to its retained source.

candidate.status: Actual retained bytes match the pinned LFS size/hash; host loaded this candidate in the original authorized run.

reference_export.status: Pinned upstream LFS declaration only in the reviewed evidence; no local acquisition, execution or reference parity.

graph.scope: All 11550 recursively reachable protobuf messages inspected, including tensor attributes/subgraphs/functions. No inference performed.

identity_and_export.export_provenance_limit: Producer metadata, hash identity and successful load do not independently identify or reproduce the original exporter settings, calibration/quantization procedure, HF source checkpoint computation, or numerical error against a full-precision reference.
identity_and_export.reference_implementation_limit: Pinned config auto_map names custom Nomic code in another repository. Before any independent reference run, pin and review the chosen native library implementation or exact custom code and all checkpoint/runtime dependencies; do not automatically execute remote code.
identity_and_export.gguf: The packet retains only pinned GGUF Q4_K_M/F16 declarations and upstream claims. Neither has been run in the reviewed experiment, so no ONNX-versus-GGUF winner is established.

what_the_original_run_measured.mode: Functional precheck on macOS arm64, JVM ONNX Runtime 1.27.0 CPU, 1 thread, batch 1, two repetitions.
what_the_original_run_measured.roles: search_query: and search_document: prefixes; three selected inputs also run with the opposite prefix, twice.
raw_stages: token IDs as i32 little endian
masked mean as f32 little endian
full 768-dimensional layer normalization as f32 little endian
first 256 dimensions then L2 as f32 little endian
what_the_original_run_measured.arithmetic_scope: For source-inferred all-one masks in these unpadded batch-one encodings, all retained means, layer-normalized vectors, normalized vectors and int8 outputs rederive exactly. This is conditional internal consistency of retained stages, not independent model correctness.

float64_postprocessing_residuals.interpretation: Descriptive recomputation from the same retained hidden states, not a separately executed model reference, error tolerance, or qualification pass.

timing.source_scope: Timer starts before constructing the three OnnxTensors, ends immediately after session.run and before getValue materialization. It is not pure kernel timing or end-to-end service latency.
timing.limits: Mixed 6–512 token inputs, no controlled warmup/batch/thread matrix. JVM/native/raw-output-retention allocations are included; macOS RSS is not Android PSS or Fold thermal/latency acceptance.

what_the_original_run_measured.binary_attribution_limit: Original manifest seals runner Java source, raw results, invocation/configuration and classpath receipts, but excludes scratch HostNomicExperiment.class. Current class bytes are recorded in metadata-review.json as current-only; no retroactive historical class attestation.
what_the_original_run_measured.tensor_retention_limit: Actual mask and token_type_ids runtime tensors were not retained. Source provides all-one mask and single-sequence zero-type construction, but raw tensors cannot be independently compared from this run.

existing_gold.reference: tokenizers 0.22.1, according to immutable fixture metadata
existing_gold.scope: Existing fixture bytes/provenance inspected and preserved. No test suite rerun, gold regeneration, or independent reference tokenization of all 131 actual experiment inputs performed.

tokenizer_and_postprocessing_boundaries.tokenizer_identity: Acquired tokenizer.json is byte-identical to decompressed checked-in Nomic test resource, SHA256 d241a60d5e8f04cc1b2b3e9ef7a4921b27bf526d9f6050ab90f9267a1f9e5c66. Test-resource identity is not production installation.
tokenizer_and_postprocessing_boundaries.length_scope: Original runner explicitly truncates to 512 including specials. Six retained rows are capped at 512; source config/card long-context metadata does not qualify execution beyond 512, mixed padding or batch sizes greater than one.
tokenizer_and_postprocessing_boundaries.required_nomic_order: Task prefix -> exact tokenizer/masks/types -> token hidden states -> masked mean -> full-width layer normalization -> slice 256 -> L2 -> shared int8 quantizer.
tokenizer_and_postprocessing_boundaries.upstream_authority: Pinned README Matryoshka examples and separately Git-blob-verified mean-pooling configuration. Card example uses a different slice size; Skein contract fixes 256. Model-internal normalization epsilon 1e-12 is distinct from scratch pooled-vector epsilon 1e-5.
tokenizer_and_postprocessing_boundaries.generic_helper_gap: Current Pooling.meanPool accumulates doubles, while scratch Java accumulates sequential float32. Pooling.matryoshkaInt8 performs slicing/L2/int8 but no full-width layer normalization. No selected backend uses these as a qualified Nomic pipeline. A future artifact-specific adapter must identify which stages its exact export includes and apply each needed stage once; these helper differences remain unqualified.
tokenizer_and_postprocessing_boundaries.onnx_adapter_gap: OnnxSession.runFloat supports one FLOAT input and flattened output; the actual Nomic export requires three INT64 inputs and named rank-three FLOAT output with validated dimensions. A production adapter has not been implemented or accepted.
tokenizer_and_postprocessing_boundaries.quantization: Original run uses unchanged Int8Quantizer clamp/round rule on normalized 256-vector. The audit reproduced all retained output bytes; reference vector/ranking drift from quantized model weights and final int8 representation remains unmeasured.

semantic_and_production_status.semantic_metrics: No retrieval, ranking, relevance, abstention or labeled development metric was produced by the original functional precheck or by this audit.

smoke_gate.fixed_requirement: Int8 cosine of the cat/mat sentence with cat/rug paraphrase must exceed its cosine with quarterly revenue report by at least 0.15, as already specified. One smoke example does not establish general quality.

semantic_and_production_status.data_policy: 128-record/48-label corpus is consumed development evidence. Repeated original runs and Fresh40 remain regression evidence; retain failures, labels and original thresholds. Never call these blind validation. Freeze distinct unseen holdout and policy before any future holdout outputs.
semantic_and_production_status.production_backend: EmbedderService default backendFactory is null; production load refuses NOT_LOADED. Host scratch execution is not production wiring or registration.
semantic_and_production_status.retained_runtime_scope: Historical actual retrieval JSON rehashed. Its zero vectors and INELIGIBLE full-hybrid result are not superseded by host arithmetic or this audit.
